About the role
 

Are you a motivated student with a passion for Human Resources and looking to gain hands-on experience in an international environment? We are looking for an enthusiastic 
HR Intern to join our Benelux HR team.
 

As an 
HR Intern Benelux, you will support the day-to-day HR activities across the Benelux region. Based in 
Belgium, you will regularly provide on-site support at our 
Brussels office as well as at our 
Dutch-speaking production sites.
 

This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of HR processes while working in a dynamic and multicultural organization.
 

 
 

We count on you to:
 
 

• Support the HR team with daily HR administration. 

• Assist & Support onboarding and offboarding activities. 

• Contribute to learning and development initiatives and HR project & HR processes. 

• Prepare and maintain HR documentation. 

• Assist with internal HR communications and employee engagement initiatives. 

• Provide regular support at our Brussels office and Dutch-speaking production sites. 

• Contribute ideas to improve and optimize HR processes.  

 
 

 
 

You can count on us to :
 

During the internship, the HR Intern will receive training in the following areas:
 
 

• HR Fundamentals 

• HR Systems & Digital Tools 

• Operational HR 

• Professional Skills 

• Compliance & Safety  

 
 

 
 

You will bring:
 
 

• You are currently 
pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Human Resource Management, Business Administration (HR), Psychology, or a related field. 

• You are based in 
Belgium. 

• You are fluent in 
Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written. 

• You are organized, accurate, and able to handle confidential information with discretion. 

• You are proactive, eager to learn, and enjoy working in a team. 

• You are interested in gaining practical HR experience within an international organization. 

• You are willing to travel regularly between our Belgian locations.  

 
 

 
 

You will get:
 
 

• A valuable internship in an international and dynamic organization. 

• Coaching and guidance from experienced HR professionals. 

• Exposure to various HR disciplines and projects. 

• A diverse and challenging internship with room for initiative and personal development. 

• An opportunity to build your professional network within the Benelux organization. 

• An Internship allowance and benefits. The Belgian gross monthly allowance can range from 500€ to 1100€.  Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualification, type of Internship agreement, internal equity and can ultimately be more or less than the posted salary range.  

 
 

 
 

Additional information:
 
 

• Location: Brussels 

• Duration: 6 months

Do you enjoy variety and like to get things done? For a family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a versatile warehouse worker who can be flexibly deployed across different departments and enjoys taking on a variety of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Assemble wooden crates for shipping large machine parts. 

- Pack parts manually and using machines. 

- Process and register documents and information in the computer system. 

- Support colleagues across different departments where needed.

- You enjoy combining physical work with administrative tasks and can easily switch between the two.

- You speak and understand English well.

- You work accurately, are flexible and have a hands-on mentality.

Do you enjoy working with metal and have an eye for detail?
 

We are looking for a Warehouse Operator for a company in Lokeren. 

You will be responsible for checking, preparing and processing returned metal machine components. You will work daytime hours in a technical working environment with a varied range of tasks.
 

What will you do?
 

- Sort and visually inspect returned metal machine components for defects. 

- Check technical drawings and verify that all parts are complete. 

- Carry out small tasks such as removing rust and touch-up painting. 

- Prepare parts for shipment. 

- Process and register parts using the internal computer system.

- You have an interest in mechanics and metalworking.

- You work accurately and in a structured way, with an eye for detail.

- You are comfortable working with computers and internal systems.

- You are a hands-on team player and speak Dutch or English

Do you like working accurately and enjoy a practical job? For the same family-run logistics company in Lokeren, we are looking for a packer who pays attention to detail and ensures that customer orders are processed correctly and efficiently.
 

What will you do?
 

- Check the quality and quantity of products before packing. 

- Carefully pack parts according to the required specifications. 

- Process orders based on instructions provided through a computer system or order form. 

- Handle parts weighing up to 10 kg.

- You speak and understand English.

- You are comfortable with standing work and handling parts up to 10 kg.

- You can work with a computer and process an order form accurately.

- You are looking for a full-time position and work in a precise and structured way.

Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators. 
 

Our capabilities cover the main aircraft types, including Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, regional and military aircraft and rotor aircraft. With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. SABCA offers a full range of services to the civil, space and military aviation markets and recently expanded into the commercial Unmanned Autonomous Systems market as an integrator of aerospace-grade solutions for the industry. 
 

Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?
 

Your Main Responsibilities:
 

Reporting to the Head of Engine Services, you will be required to perform the following:

• Engine Storage, Humidity Checks and Humidity Corrections 

• Engine Preservation 

• Engine Boroscope inspection 

• Engine Boroblending  

• Engine handling, QEC removal and installation 

• Engine inspection at major module level, Inventory Checks and Lease Return Work Scope (LRWS) / C-Checks iaw B-rating 

• Engine Identification Plug TST/REP iaw C-rating 

• Replacement of external engine parts 

• Maintain and operate ES tooling 

• Maintain and follow-up of local products 
 

• Full understanding of ATA 100 system and working knowledge of interactions between AMM, ESM, CMM 

• Capability of reading, understanding and implementation of service bulletins and airworthy documentation 

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level

• You have a part 66 B1, B1/B2, B1/C or B1/B2/ C license or equivalent shop training/experience on CFM56 and/or V2500 and/or LEAP 1A/1B engines

Our client is an international organization with a strong reputation in its sector and operations across multiple European markets. Known for its commitment to quality, responsible business practices, and continuous improvement, the company offers a collaborative and multicultural environment where people play a central role in driving success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting both employees and managers across several countries and functions.

Acting as a trusted HR partner, you will accompany teams throughout the employee lifecycle, provide day-to-day guidance on people-related topics, and help managers create engaging and high-performing work environments.

This role combines operational involvement with strategic HR initiatives. You will spend time close to the business, understanding the realities of different teams, supporting managers in their people challenges, and ensuring a consistent employee experience across the organization.

HR Partnership & Employee Support

• Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers within your assigned business areas.
• Build strong relationships with teams and maintain a close understanding of business and people challenges.
• Support managers in addressing day-to-day HR topics, employee engagement, team dynamics, and people development.
• Accompany employees throughout their journey within the company, ensuring a positive and consistent experience.
• Regularly connect with teams across different locations to stay close to operational realities.

Employee Relations & People Management

• Advise and support managers on employee relations matters, performance concerns, wellbeing topics, and workplace issues.
• Ensure people decisions are aligned with company policies and local employment regulations.
• Facilitate constructive dialogue between managers and employees when needed.
• Support disciplinary processes and sensitive employee cases with professionalism and discretion.

Talent & Performance

• Coordinate performance management and talent review processes within your scope.
• Support managers in identifying development opportunities and building individual growth plans.
• Contribute to initiatives aimed at strengthening leadership and team capabilities.
• Participate in succession planning and talent development discussions.

Employee Experience & Engagement

• Support onboarding and integration activities to ensure a strong employee experience from day one.
• Contribute to engagement initiatives and help foster a collaborative and inclusive culture.
• Gather feedback from employees and managers and translate insights into practical improvements.
• Promote a culture of continuous feedback and development.

HR Projects & Continuous Improvement

• Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, and the implementation of new initiatives.
• Help improve HR tools, policies, and ways of working.
• Support HR reporting and analysis when required.
• Collaborate closely with other HR functions to ensure a seamless employee experience.

Experience & Background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
• More than 7 years of experience as HR Business Partner within an international and fast-paced environment.
• Proven experience supporting both managers and employees across a broad range of HR topics.
• Strong exposure to employee relations, performance management, talent development, and organizational change.
• Good understanding of European employment legislation; experience across multiple countries is an asset.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility at all levels of the organization.
• Hands-on and pragmatic approach, with a genuine interest in supporting people and solving problems.
• Excellent communication and coaching skills.
• Ability to manage sensitive situations with discretion and professionalism.
• Well-organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Data-aware, with good knowledge of HR systems and reporting tools.
• Fluent in French and English; additional European languages are considered a plus.
• Collaborative, approachable, and committed to delivering an excellent employee experience.
